title: Hinchr
tagline: Fan loyalty app built with zk login technology. Get rewards, safe ticket sales, and more!
description:
Hinchr is a fan identity, loyalty, and ticketing platform that helps sports clubs better connect with supporters while improving stadium operations and fan engagement.

Today, fan data is fragmented across ticketing systems, memberships, stadium purchases, and sponsor programs. This makes it difficult for clubs to understand their audience, reward loyalty, and maximize stadium occupancy. At the same time, ticket scalping and uncontrolled resale reduce trust and create a poor experience for genuine fans.

Hinchr introduces a tiered on-chain identity system. Fans can start with a simple account created through Sui zkLogin, allowing them to purchase and hold ticket NFTs while remaining anonymous. Members can upgrade to an ENS-based identity to access loyalty points, rewards, discounts, rankings, and crypto payments. Superfans can verify their uniqueness with World ID to unlock advanced benefits and participate in a regulated ticket resale marketplace designed to reduce scalping.

For clubs, Hinchr provides a unified view of fan activity across attendance, purchases, memberships, and loyalty programs, creating valuable business intelligence and stronger sponsor opportunities. For fans, it offers ownership of identity, meaningful rewards, and safer ticketing.

Built with Sui, ENS, and World ID, Hinchr creates a more connected, rewarding, and transparent ecosystem for clubs and supporters.
how_its_made:
Built on SUI, with zk login. Tier 2 (member) can be achieved via minting an ENS subdomain, which allows the member to do all stadium and ticket purchases in stablecoins to earn rewards and discounts. For the top tier of superfan, a world id verification is necessary.

Tickets are automatically minted as NFT's on sui and dropped into the user's wallet. Each transaction is privacy-preserving by default.
auto_summary: Hinchr is a sports fan identity and ticketing concept centered on tiered on-chain accounts, NFT tickets, and loyalty features.
